recommendation: Keep the source fix. It completes the applied FHIR-34195 decision in the active MedicationRequest StructureDefinition source without reopening later naming or modifier questions around isRecordOfRequest.
issue_request: FHIR-34195 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request for R5 asking that the non-mandatory boolean MedicationRequest.reported have a meaningIfMissing. The approved resolution said that, if missing, the request is assumed to be the original record and not reported.
initial_application: Commit 886f421a86f818e31e5eb518a478fcffae6c71db added the approved sentence to MedicationRequest.reported, but as ElementDefinition.comment rather than the structured missing-value field.
additional_context: MedicationRequest is active build input in source/fhir.ini, assigned to Pharmacy, and the current fhir.ini R5/R6 map records MedicationRequest.reported[x] as MedicationRequest.isRecordOfRequest. Later FHIR-49863 current-source work renamed reported to isRecordOfRequest and preserved the sentence, but that issue is only Resolved - change required and was not decided here. Focused Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting guidance.
reconciliation: Moved the approved sentence in source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml from comment to meaningWhenMissing on MedicationRequest.isRecordOfRequest.
source_changes: source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml: replaced the FHIR-34195 missing-value comment on MedicationRequest.isRecordOfRequest with meaningWhenMissing using the same approved text.

related_jiras.note: Renamed MedicationRequest.reported to MedicationRequest.isRecordOfRequest in current source and preserved the FHIR-34195 sentence; it explains why the reconciliation edits the renamed element but is not itself decided here.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request asking that non-mandatory MedicationRequest.reported have meaningIfMissing, with approved text that missing means the original record and not reported.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes final WG intent and the missing-value semantics that must be encoded in current source.

evidence_items.summary: MedicationRequest is an active resource, assigned to Pharmacy, and maps MedicationRequest.reported[x] to current MedicationRequest.isRecordOfRequest.
evidence_items.learned: The edited MedicationRequest StructureDefinition is in current build scope and the renamed element carries the seed issue forward.

evidence_items.summary: MedicationRequest.isRecordOfRequest is a 0..1 boolean and now carries the approved sentence in meaningWhenMissing.
evidence_items.learned: The current source now encodes the requested optional-boolean missing-value semantics in the structured ElementDefinition field.

evidence_items.summary: The original FHIR-34195 application added the approved sentence to MedicationRequest.reported as an ElementDefinition.comment.
evidence_items.learned: The issue was partially applied in 2022, but to the wrong ElementDefinition field for a meaningIfMissing request.
